title: 10 iconic landmarks on the Seoul Marathon course
publisher: Seoul Marathon Organizing Committee (The Dong-A Ilbo)
claims: The official landmark list along the full course includes Gwanghwamun Square, Seoul City Hall, Sungnyemun Gate, Dongdaemun Design Plaza, Cheonggyecheon Stream, Heunginjimun Gate and Seoul Children's Grand Park.
The Children's Grand Park in Gwangjin-gu sits at the challenging 28 km mark; the 11 km Cheonggyecheon stream runs through Jongno-gu and Jung-gu in the early stage.
